sakura.title: Bike parking
sakura.desc: Posted August. The second-floor rack is closed.
sakura.q_bike: Where do I put my bike?
sakura.a_bike_lead: Ground floor, under the roof. Lock the front wheel.
sakura.a_bike_rest: The second-floor rack is closed from August for repairs. Do not leave a bike in the hallway; by the next morning it will be moved to the store room with the wheel lock off. To collect it, ring the manager's bell by the mailboxes. Visitor bikes use the three unmarked stands by the gate, not the numbered ones.
sakura.q_guest: Where do guests park a car?
sakura.a_guest: They don't. No spaces. Use the coin lot across the street.
sakura.quote: Second-floor rack is out until next month. Rear of the ground floor only.
